## Overview

Sony Xperia 5 V is listed in our worldwide phone directory. Country or market recorded: not recorded. This is an evergreen reference guide, not a new launch or a claim that the institution or product was recently announced.

## Source-listed information

- **Introduced:** 2023-01-01
- **Manufacturer:** Sony Mobile
- **Display:** 6.1 in (150 mm) OLED Full HD+ (2520×1080 pixels) CinemaWide display 120Hz refresh rate HDR support Gorilla Glass Victus 2
- **Processor:** Octa-core (1x 3.2 GHz Cortex-X3 , 2x 2.8 GHz Cortex-A715 , 2x 2.8 GHz Cortex-A710 , 3x 2.0 GHz Cortex-A510 )
- **Battery:** Non-removable lithium-ion battery 5000 mAh , 18.91 Wh
- **Ram:** LPDDR5X RAM 8 GB
- **Storage:** Universal Flash Storage (UFS 3.1) 128 GB 256 GB
- **Cameras:** 48 MP, f/1.9, 24mm (wide), 1/1.35", 1.12µm, dual pixel PDAF, OIS (Sony Exmor T IMX888/Lytia LYT-800) 12 MP, f/2.2, 16mm (ultrawide), 1/2.5", dual pixel PDAF (Sony Exmor RS IMX563) Features Zeiss optics, Zeiss T* lens coating, color spectrum sensor, LED flash, panorama, HDR, eye tracking Video: 4K@24/25/30/60/120fps HDR, 1080p@30/60/120fps; 5-axis gyro-EIS, OIS, HDR
- **Charging:** Fast Charging USB PD 3.1 30 W Charging Qi 11 W Wireless Charging
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax (2.4/5GHz) Bluetooth 5.3 USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 (supports DisplayPort ) NFC GPS with Assisted GPS Galileo GLONASS BeiDou
- **Os:** Android 13 (Upgradable to Android 15 ) Up to 2 years of OS upgrades and 3 years of security updates
- **Front Camera:** 12 MP, f/2.0, 24mm (wide), 1/2.9", 1.25µm (Sony Exmor RS IMX663) Features HDR Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60fps, 5-axis gyro-EIS
- **Weight:** 182 g (6.4 oz)
- **Dimensions:** dimensions: 154 mm (6.1 in) H 68 mm (2.7 in) W 8.6 mm (0.34 in) D
- **Protection:** Water and dust resistant ( IP65/IP68 )
- **Color:** Black, Blue, Platinum Silver
